26563    /// A default stop ends a pause, which Linux then restarts once the process
26564    /// continues (`Detcore::handle_pause` returns `ERESTARTNOHAND`), but never a
26565    /// `nanosleep`, whose restart would have to keep its deadline: the stop
26566    /// takes effect when the sleep ends. A caught or fatal signal ends both.
26567    #[test]
26568    fn a_default_stop_ends_a_pause_but_not_a_nanosleep() {
26569        let deadline = LogicalTime::from_nanos(5_000_000_000);
26570        for signal in [libc::SIGTSTP, libc::SIGSTOP] {
26571            let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
26572            let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, PAUSE_FYI, false);
26573            set_sleeper_state(&mut scheduler, target, sleeper_state(0, 0, 0, 0));
26574            send_cross_task(&mut scheduler, target, &[signal], None);
26575            assert_sleep_woken(
26576                &scheduler,
26577                target,
26578                &[signal],
26579                &format!("pause, signal {signal}"),
26580            );
26581
26582            let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
26583            let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, deadline, NANOSLEEP_FYI, false);
26584            assert_eq!(
26585                scheduler.signal_sleep(target),
26586                Some(SignalSleep::Nanosleep { deadline })
26587            );
26588            set_sleeper_state(&mut scheduler, target, sleeper_state(0, 0, 0, 0));
26589            send_cross_task(&mut scheduler, target, &[signal], None);
26590            assert_sleep_parked(
26591                &scheduler,
26592                target,
26593                deadline,
26594                &format!("nanosleep, signal {signal}"),
26595            );
26596        }
26597        for (signal, caught) in [(libc::SIGUSR1, true), (libc::SIGTERM, false)] {
26598            let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
26599            let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, deadline, NANOSLEEP_FYI, false);
26600            let caught_set = if caught { kernel_signal_bit(signal) } else { 0 };
26601            set_sleeper_state(&mut scheduler, target, sleeper_state(caught_set, 0, 0, 0));
26602            send_cross_task(&mut scheduler, target, &[signal], None);
26603            assert_sleep_woken(
26604                &scheduler,
26605                target,
26606                &[signal],
26607                &format!("nanosleep, signal {signal}"),
26608            );
26609        }
26610    }
26611
26612    /// A signal drained once a `nanosleep`'s deadline has passed leaves the
26613    /// sleep to complete normally at its timed pop, as Linux completes a sleep
26614    /// whose timer has fired; the signal is delivered as the call returns.
26615    #[test]
26616    fn a_cross_task_signal_after_a_nanosleep_deadline_leaves_it_to_complete() {
26617        let deadline = LogicalTime::from_nanos(5_000_000_000);
26618        for committed in [deadline, deadline + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1)] {
26619            let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
26620            let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, deadline, NANOSLEEP_FYI, false);
26621            scheduler.committed_time = committed;
26622            let usr1 = kernel_signal_bit(libc::SIGUSR1);
26623            set_sleeper_state(&mut scheduler, target, sleeper_state(usr1, 0, 0, 0));
26624            send_cross_task(&mut scheduler, target, &[libc::SIGUSR1], None);
26625            assert_sleep_parked(
26626                &scheduler,
26627                target,
26628                deadline,
26629                &format!("committed {committed}"),
26630            );
26631        }
26632    }

26634    /// What is not recorded at all: a `SIGKILL`, which the kernel acts on for
26635    /// a traced thread without the thread running, as before; a sleep request
26636    /// that is neither a tagged `pause` nor a tagged `nanosleep`; and any sleep
26637    /// on a backend that does not report the guest's signal state, which keeps
26638    /// its previous behavior.
26639    #[test]
26640    fn sleeps_that_cross_task_signals_do_not_reach() {
26641        let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
26642        let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, PAUSE_FYI, false);
26643        scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper(libc::SIGKILL));
26644        assert!(scheduler.pending_cross_task_signals.is_empty(), "SIGKILL");
26645
26646        let deadline = LogicalTime::from_nanos(5_000_000_000);
26647        for (deadline, fyi) in [
26648            (deadline, ""),
26649            (deadline, PAUSE_FYI),
26650            (LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, ""),
26651        ] {
26652            let mut scheduler = gated_scheduler();
26653            let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, deadline, fyi, false);
26654            assert_eq!(scheduler.signal_sleep(target), None, "{deadline} {fyi:?}");
26655            scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper(libc::SIGTERM));
26656            assert!(
26657                scheduler.pending_cross_task_signals.is_empty(),
26658                "{deadline} {fyi:?}"
26659            );
26660        }
26661
26662        for (deadline, fyi) in [
26663            (LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, PAUSE_FYI),
26664            (deadline, NANOSLEEP_FYI),
26665        ] {
26666            let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&Config {
26667                sequentialize_threads: true,
26668                ..Config::default()
26669            });
26670            assert!(!scheduler.models_signal_targets);
26671            let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, deadline, fyi, false);
26672            assert_eq!(scheduler.signal_sleep(target), None, "{fyi}");
26673            scheduler.notify_signal_pending(target, SigWrapper(libc::SIGTERM));
26674            assert!(scheduler.pending_cross_task_signals.is_empty(), "{fyi}");
26675        }
26676    }

26678    #[test]
26679    fn backoff_sleep_doubles_each_round_then_caps() {
26680        let got: Vec<u64> = (1..=15).map(backoff_sleep_micros).collect();
26681        assert_eq!(
26682            got,
26683            vec![

26685            ]

26688    /// File the exact owner-turn snapshot without registering a real host PID.
26689    fn in_guest_alarm_sleep(
26690        deadline: LogicalTime,
26691        fyi: &str,
26692        snapshot: crate::resources::InGuestSleepSigalrm,
26693        queued: bool,
26694    ) -> (Scheduler, DetTid, Resources) {
26695        let config = Config {
26696            sequentialize_threads: true,
26697            ..Config::default()
26698        }
26699        .with_backend(|backend| *backend = BackendCapabilities::LITEINST_IN_GUEST);
26700        let mut scheduler = Scheduler::new(&config);
26701        let target = filed_sleep(&mut scheduler, deadline, fyi, queued);
26702        scheduler.thread_tree.add_child(target, target, true);
26703        scheduler
26704            .exec_incarnations
26705            .insert(target, MmId::initial(target));
26706        let mut request = scheduler.next_turns[&target]
26707            .req
26708            .try_read()
26709            .unwrap()
26710            .unwrap();
26711        request.in_guest_sleep_sigalrm = Some(snapshot);
26712        scheduler.next_turns.get_mut(&target).unwrap().req = Ivar::full(Ok(request.clone()));
26713        (scheduler, target, request)
26714    }
26715
26716    fn default_sleep_alarm_snapshot() -> crate::resources::InGuestSleepSigalrm {
26717        crate::resources::InGuestSleepSigalrm {
26718            disposition: crate::resources::SigalrmSleepDisposition::Default,
26719            blocked: false,
26720        }
26721    }
26722
26723    /// Drive the real pop, diversion and typed grant boundaries directly,
26724    /// so an unexpected rejection cannot send a physical signal to a fake PID.
26725    /// Guest probes exercise the complete dispatcher against real targets.
26726    #[test]
26727    fn in_guest_one_shot_alarm_grants_fatal_sleep_without_host_send() {
26728        let expiry = LogicalTime::from_nanos(10);
26729        for (deadline, fyi) in [
26730            (LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, PAUSE_FYI),
26731            (LogicalTime::from_nanos(20), NANOSLEEP_FYI),
26732        ] {
26733            for normal_due in [true, false] {
26734                let (mut scheduler, target, original) =
26735                    in_guest_alarm_sleep(deadline, fyi, default_sleep_alarm_snapshot(), false);
26736                scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.insert_alarm(
26737                    expiry,
26738                    target,
26739                    target,
26740                    Signal::SIGALRM,
26741                    LogicalTime::ZERO,
26742                );
26743                let (event_ns, TimedEvent::SignalEvt(id, tid, signal)) =
26744                    scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.pop().unwrap()
26745                else {
26746                    panic!("the alarm must expire before its sleep");
26747                };
26748                assert_eq!(event_ns, expiry);
26749                assert_eq!(scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.alarm_state(target), None);
26750                // Models empty-queue dispatch with committed_time still behind
26751                // the event, as well as the ordinary due-event path.
26752                scheduler.committed_time = if normal_due {
26753                    expiry
26754                } else {
26755                    LogicalTime::ZERO
26756                };
26757                let turn_before = scheduler.turn;
26758                let committed_before = scheduler.committed_time;
26759                let observed_now = if normal_due {
26760                    expiry
26761                } else {
26762                    expiry + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1)
26763                };
26764                assert!(scheduler.divert_in_guest_fatal_alarm(
26765                    event_ns,
26766                    id,
26767                    tid.tid(),
26768                    match signal {
26769                        timed_waiters::TimerSignal::Send(signal) => signal,
26770                        other => panic!("an alarm sends a deliverable signal, not {other}"),
26771                    },
26772                    observed_now
26773                ));
26774                assert_eq!(
26775                    scheduler.turn, turn_before,
26776                    "diversion is not an extra guest grant"
26777                );
26778                assert_eq!(scheduler.committed_time, committed_before);
26779                assert_eq!(scheduler.host_signal_attempts, 0);
26780                assert!(scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_pending(target));
26781                assert_eq!(
26782                    scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.thread_deadline(target),
26783                    None
26784                );
26785                assert_eq!(
26786                    scheduler
26787                        .run_queue
26788                        .tids()
26789                        .filter(|tid| **tid == target)
26790                        .count(),
26791                    1
26792                );
26793
26794                // A later signal and even a direct generic substitution cannot
26795                // steal the typed response from the consumed alarm.
26796                scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGCHLD);
26797                scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGUSR1);
26798                let mut generic = Resources::new(target);
26799                generic.insert(
26800                    ResourceID::InboundSignal(SigWrapper(libc::SIGCHLD)),
26801                    Permission::W,
26802                );
26803                scheduler.force_unblock_thread(target, generic);
26804                assert!(scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_pending(target));
26805                assert_eq!(
26806                    scheduler
26807                        .run_queue
26808                        .tids()
26809                        .filter(|tid| **tid == target)
26810                        .count(),
26811                    1
26812                );
26813
26814                let response = scheduler.next_turns[&target].resp.clone();
26815                assert!(scheduler.unblock_guest(target, &response).is_ok());
26816                assert_eq!(
26817                    scheduler.turn,
26818                    turn_before + 1,
26819                    "the fatal continuation consumes exactly one ordinary grant"
26820                );
26821                assert!(matches!(
26822                    response.try_read(),
26823                    Some(SchedResponse::InGuestFatalAlarm)
26824                ));
26825                assert!(scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(
26826                    target,
26827                    target,
26828                    Some(MmId::initial(target)),
26829                    &original,
26830                ));
26831                assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_pending(target));
26832                assert_eq!(scheduler.host_signal_attempts, 0);
26833            }
26834        }
26835    }

26837    #[test]
26838    fn in_guest_ignored_and_blocked_alarm_preserve_filed_or_parked_sleep() {
26839        use crate::resources::InGuestSleepSigalrm;
26840        use crate::resources::SigalrmSleepDisposition;
26841        for snapshot in [
26842            InGuestSleepSigalrm {
26843                disposition: SigalrmSleepDisposition::Ignored,
26844                blocked: false,
26845            },
26846            InGuestSleepSigalrm {
26847                disposition: SigalrmSleepDisposition::Default,
26848                blocked: true,
26849            },
26850            InGuestSleepSigalrm {
26851                disposition: SigalrmSleepDisposition::Handled,
26852                blocked: true,
26853            },
26854        ] {
26855            for (deadline, fyi) in [
26856                (LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, PAUSE_FYI),
26857                (LogicalTime::from_nanos(20), NANOSLEEP_FYI),
26858            ] {
26859                for queued in [false, true] {
26860                    let (mut scheduler, target, _) =
26861                        in_guest_alarm_sleep(deadline, fyi, snapshot, queued);
26862                    assert!(!scheduler.divert_in_guest_fatal_alarm(
26863                        LogicalTime::from_nanos(10),
26864                        timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Alarm(target),
26865                        target,
26866                        Signal::SIGALRM,
26867                        LogicalTime::ZERO
26868                    ));
26869                    // This method is the wake half after a successful physical
26870                    // send. Kernel pending semantics belong to the guest probes.
26871                    scheduler.wake_signaled_guest(target, Signal::SIGALRM);
26872                    assert_eq!(scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target), queued);
26873                    assert_eq!(
26874                        scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.thread_deadline(target),
26875                        (!queued).then_some(deadline)
26876                    );
26877                    assert_eq!(
26878                        scheduler.next_turns[&target]
26879                            .req
26880                            .try_read()
26881                            .unwrap()
26882                            .unwrap()
26883                            .in_guest_sigalrm_sleep(),
26884                        Some((snapshot, deadline))
26885                    );
26886                    assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_pending(target));
26887                }
26888            }
26889        }
26890    }

26892    #[test]
26893    fn in_guest_fatal_alarm_excludes_other_identities_and_rearmed_timers() {
26894        let (mut scheduler, target, _) = in_guest_alarm_sleep(
26895            LogicalTime::INDEFINITE,
26896            PAUSE_FYI,
26897            default_sleep_alarm_snapshot(),
26898            false,
26899        );
26900        let expiry = LogicalTime::from_nanos(10);
26901        for (id, signal) in [
26902            (
26903                timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Posix(target, 1),
26904                Signal::SIGALRM,
26905            ),
26906            (
26907                timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::ChildExit {
26908                    child: DetPid::from_raw(200),
26909                    parent: target,
26910                },
26911                Signal::SIGALRM,
26912            ),
26913            (
26914                timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Alarm(DetPid::from_raw(200)),
26915                Signal::SIGALRM,
26916            ),
26917            (timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Alarm(target), Signal::SIGUSR1),
26918        ] {
26919            assert!(!scheduler.divert_in_guest_fatal_alarm(
26920                expiry,
26921                id,
26922                target,
26923                signal,
26924                LogicalTime::ZERO
26925            ));
26926        }
26927        for interval in [LogicalTime::ZERO, LogicalTime::from_nanos(5)] {
26928            scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.insert_alarm(
26929                expiry,
26930                target,
26931                target,
26932                Signal::SIGALRM,
26933                interval,
26934            );
26935            if interval != LogicalTime::ZERO {
26936                assert!(matches!(
26937                    scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.pop(),
26938                    Some((_, TimedEvent::SignalEvt(..)))
26939                ));
26940            }
26941            assert!(
26942                scheduler
26943                    .blocked
26944                    .timed_waiters
26945                    .alarm_state(target)
26946                    .is_some(),
26947                "unconsumed one-shot or rearmed recurring identity"
26948            );
26949            assert!(!scheduler.divert_in_guest_fatal_alarm(
26950                expiry,
26951                timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Alarm(target),
26952                target,
26953                Signal::SIGALRM,
26954                LogicalTime::ZERO
26955            ));
26956        }
26957        assert_eq!(
26958            scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.thread_deadline(target),
26959            Some(LogicalTime::INDEFINITE)
26960        );
26961        assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
26962    }

26964    #[test]
26965    fn in_guest_fatal_alarm_excludes_unqualified_requests_and_states() {
26966        let expiry = LogicalTime::from_nanos(10);
26967        for case in 0..10 {
26968            let (mut scheduler, target, mut request) = in_guest_alarm_sleep(
26969                LogicalTime::from_nanos(20),
26970                NANOSLEEP_FYI,
26971                default_sleep_alarm_snapshot(),
26972                false,
26973            );
26974            match case {
26975                0 => scheduler.backend = Config::default().backend,
26976                1 => request.in_guest_sleep_sigalrm = None,
26977                2 => request.fyi = String::new(),
26978                3 => request.insert(ResourceID::TraceReplay, Permission::W),
26979                4 => {
26980                    scheduler.runqueue_push_back(target);
26981                }
26982                5 => scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.remove(target),
26983                6 => {
26984                    scheduler
26985                        .thread_tree
26986                        .add_child(target, DetTid::from_raw(101), false);
26987                }
26988                7 => {
26989                    let mut hb = hb_runtime(HB_GATE_SPEC);
26990                    hb.parked.insert(target);
26991                    scheduler.happens_before = Some(hb);
26992                }
26993                8 => {
26994                    scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.remove(target);
26995                    scheduler
26996                        .blocked
26997                        .timed_waiters
26998                        .insert(LogicalTime::from_nanos(21), target);
26999                }
27000                9 => {
27001                    request.in_guest_sleep_sigalrm.as_mut().unwrap().disposition =
27002                        crate::resources::SigalrmSleepDisposition::Handled;
27003                }
27004                _ => unreachable!(),
27005            }
27006            scheduler.next_turns.get_mut(&target).unwrap().req = Ivar::full(Ok(request));
27007            assert!(
27008                !scheduler.divert_in_guest_fatal_alarm(
27009                    expiry,
27010                    timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Alarm(target),
27011                    target,
27012                    Signal::SIGALRM,
27013                    LogicalTime::ZERO
27014                ),
27015                "case {case}"
27016            );
27017            assert!(
27018                !scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_pending(target),
27019                "case {case}"
27020            );
27021        }
27022    }

27024    #[test]
27025    fn in_guest_fatal_alarm_excludes_sleep_deadline_equality_and_already_ahead_time() {
27026        let deadline = LogicalTime::from_nanos(20);
27027        for (committed, event_ns, observed_now) in [
27028            (LogicalTime::ZERO, deadline, LogicalTime::ZERO),
27029            (
27030                LogicalTime::ZERO,
27031                deadline + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1),
27032                LogicalTime::ZERO,
27033            ),
27034            (deadline, LogicalTime::from_nanos(10), LogicalTime::ZERO),
27035            (
27036                deadline + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1),
27037                LogicalTime::from_nanos(10),
27038                LogicalTime::ZERO,
27039            ),
27040            // A control hook crossed the sleep deadline while committed_time
27041            // and the popped event still lag. The clock must not rewind into
27042            // permission to interrupt a completed sleep.
27043            (LogicalTime::ZERO, LogicalTime::from_nanos(10), deadline),
27044            (
27045                LogicalTime::ZERO,
27046                LogicalTime::from_nanos(10),
27047                deadline + LogicalTime::from_nanos(1),
27048            ),
27049        ] {
27050            let (mut scheduler, target, _) = in_guest_alarm_sleep(
27051                deadline,
27052                NANOSLEEP_FYI,
27053                default_sleep_alarm_snapshot(),
27054                false,
27055            );
27056            scheduler.committed_time = committed;
27057            assert!(!scheduler.divert_in_guest_fatal_alarm(
27058                event_ns,
27059                timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Alarm(target),
27060                target,
27061                Signal::SIGALRM,
27062                observed_now
27063            ));
27064            assert_eq!(
27065                scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.thread_deadline(target),
27066                Some(deadline)
27067            );
27068            assert!(!scheduler.run_queue.contains_tid(target));
27069        }
27070    }

27072    #[test]
27073    fn in_guest_fatal_response_requires_original_sleep_current_mm_and_owned_grant() {
27074        let (mut scheduler, target, original) = in_guest_alarm_sleep(
27075            LogicalTime::INDEFINITE,
27076            PAUSE_FYI,
27077            default_sleep_alarm_snapshot(),
27078            false,
27079        );
27080        let mm = MmId::initial(target);
27081        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(
27082            target,
27083            target,
27084            Some(mm),
27085            &original
27086        ));
27087        assert!(scheduler.divert_in_guest_fatal_alarm(
27088            LogicalTime::from_nanos(10),
27089            timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Alarm(target),
27090            target,
27091            Signal::SIGALRM,
27092            LogicalTime::ZERO
27093        ));
27094        let response = scheduler.next_turns[&target].resp.clone();
27095        assert!(scheduler.unblock_guest(target, &response).is_ok());
27096        assert!(scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(
27097            target,
27098            target,
27099            Some(mm),
27100            &original
27101        ));
27102        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(target, target, None, &original));
27103        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(
27104            target,
27105            DetPid::from_raw(200),
27106            Some(mm),
27107            &original
27108        ));
27109        let mut unqualified = original.clone();
27110        unqualified.in_guest_sleep_sigalrm = None;
27111        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(
27112            target,
27113            target,
27114            Some(mm),
27115            &unqualified
27116        ));
27117        let mut fabricated = Resources::new(target);
27118        fabricated.insert(ResourceID::InGuestFatalAlarm, Permission::W);
27119        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(
27120            target,
27121            target,
27122            Some(mm),
27123            &fabricated
27124        ));
27125        scheduler
27126            .exec_incarnations
27127            .insert(target, MmId::initial(DetPid::from_raw(200)));
27128        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(
27129            target,
27130            target,
27131            Some(mm),
27132            &original
27133        ));
27134        scheduler.exec_incarnations.insert(target, mm);
27135        scheduler.parked.running = None;
27136        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_response_matches(
27137            target,
27138            target,
27139            Some(mm),
27140            &original
27141        ));
27142    }

27144    #[test]
27145    fn in_guest_fatal_alarm_retirement_leaves_no_pending_typed_request() {
27146        let (mut scheduler, target, _) = in_guest_alarm_sleep(
27147            LogicalTime::INDEFINITE,
27148            PAUSE_FYI,
27149            default_sleep_alarm_snapshot(),
27150            false,
27151        );
27152        assert!(scheduler.divert_in_guest_fatal_alarm(
27153            LogicalTime::from_nanos(10),
27154            timed_waiters::SignalTimerId::Alarm(target),
27155            target,
27156            Signal::SIGALRM,
27157            LogicalTime::ZERO
27158        ));
27159        let response = scheduler.next_turns[&target].resp.clone();
27160        scheduler.logically_kill_thread(&target, &target, MmId::initial(target));
27161        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_pending(target));
27162        assert!(!scheduler.next_turns.contains_key(&target));
27163        assert_eq!(
27164            scheduler.blocked.timed_waiters.thread_deadline(target),
27165            None
27166        );
27167        assert!(matches!(
27168            response.try_read(),
27169            Some(SchedResponse::Signaled(None))
27170        ));
27171    }

27173    #[test]
27174    fn in_guest_handled_sleep_alarm_still_uses_existing_ledger() {
27175        let snapshot = crate::resources::InGuestSleepSigalrm {
27176            disposition: crate::resources::SigalrmSleepDisposition::Handled,
27177            blocked: false,
27178        };
27179        let (mut scheduler, target, _) =
27180            in_guest_alarm_sleep(LogicalTime::INDEFINITE, PAUSE_FYI, snapshot, false);
27181        scheduler.set_sigalrm_handled(target, true);
27182        scheduler.set_sigalrm_blocked(target, false);
27183        assert!(scheduler.divert_sigalrm(target, Signal::SIGALRM));
27184        assert!(scheduler.sigalrm_pending(target));
27185        assert!(!scheduler.in_guest_fatal_alarm_pending(target));
27186        assert_eq!(scheduler.host_signal_attempts, 0);
27187    }
